title: 12 Best Vegan Restaurants in Tokyo for Every Taste
description: Discover Tokyo's top vegan restaurants, from traditional Japanese shojin ryori to innovative ramen and international cuisine. Your ultimate guide to plant-based dining in the bustling capital.

places.name: Saido
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Niku-no-Sushi' (meat-free sushi) or the Chef's Omakase Course for a full journey.

places.name: T's TanTan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The White Sesame TanTanmen, known for its creamy, nutty broth and a hint of spice.

places.name: Ain Soph. Journey
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Heavenly Pancakes' (matcha or original) for dessert, or the 'Omakase Plate' for a savory main.

places.name: Komaki Shokudo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Komaki Set Meal,' which changes daily based on seasonal availability, offering a true taste of authentic Shojin Ryori.

places.name: Nagi Shokudo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order a few different small plates (delis) from the counter, along with their 'karaage' (fried soy chicken) and brown rice.

places.name: Veganic to go
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Soy Meat Burger' for a classic satisfying meal, or a nutrient-packed smoothie.

places.name: Brown Rice by Neal's Yard Remedies
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Brown Rice Meal Set' (玄米ごはん定食), which features seasonal vegetables, miso soup, and pickles, perfectly embodying their philosophy.

places.name: Ballon Tokyo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Classic Falafel Sandwich' (ピタパンサンド) with a side of hummus and fresh herbs.

places.name: Izakaya Masaka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Vegan Karaage' (fried chicken-style) and the 'Gyokai Fry' (fried seafood-style) are must-tries.

places.name: Terra Cafe Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal vegan pasta dishes or one of their beautifully crafted vegan cakes.

places.name: Universal Bakes & Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their croissants (plain or flavored) or the vegan 'yakisoba-pan' (fried noodle sandwich bread) for a unique Japanese bakery experience.

places.name: 2foods (Shibuya Loft)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Miracle Noodle Ramen' for a guilt-free yet satisfying ramen experience, or one of their colorful smoothie bowls.
